description: 해양수산부_해운항만물류정보_항만업체변경신청정보 [ports and harbours] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 해양수산부. 항만업체변경신청정보는 해당 업체가 등록한 업체정보에 수정사항이 있을 시 해운항만물류정보시스템(Port-MIS)을 통해 신청하며, 관련 서식으로는 항만관련업체(신규/변경)신고서를 작성하여. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 해양수산부. Its tags are 해운항만, 항만업체, 업체정보, 변경신청, 신청정보. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-09-05 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
